2608.28155.title: FinExam-10K: When Retrieval Helps Financial Reasoning?
2608.28155.paper_summary: Professional financial examinations require models to combine domain knowledge, calculation, and judgment, yet no benchmark covers the full CFA and FRM structure under one protocol. We introduce FinExam-10K, to our knowledge the largest reported English benchmark for this setting, with 10,198 expert-reannotated questions spanning CFA Levels I-III and FRM Parts I-II. We release 5,110 questions and sequester 5,088 for a quarterly maintained leaderboard. To separate coverage from local answerability, we report a 10,198-item Full-Coverage Track and a 7,625-item Context-Complete Reasoning Track, which is the primary basis for claims about reasoning from the supplied record. Across 17 models, the best accuracy is 85.29% overall. On the frozen Hard band, the best score is 34.68% on the Full-Coverage Track and 54.57% on the 372 context-complete items. All 17 models share 47 context-complete failures. Function-RAG and FunctionGraph-RAG rescue hundreds of errors but also overturn many correct answers, producing little or negative net gain. A gate trained only on public data decides from the question and initial response when FunctionGraph-RAG should run. On the 5,088 held-out items, the gate invokes FunctionGraph-RAG for 7.9% of questions and improves accuracy from 70.83% to 71.23% (p = .0446).
2608.28155.paper_summary_zh: 專業的金融考試需要模型結合領域知識、計算和判斷，但目前沒有一個基準能在一個協議下涵蓋完整的CFA和FRM結構。我們介紹了FinExam-10K，據我們所知，這是目前報告的最大英文基準，擁有10,198個專家重新標註的問題，涵蓋CFA I-III級和FRM I-II部分。我們釋出5,110個問題，並將5,088個問題隔離以維護季度排行榜。為了將覆蓋範圍與地方可回答性區分開來，我們報告了一個10,198項的全覆蓋追蹤和一個7,625項的上下文完整推理追蹤，這是關於從提供的記錄推理聲明的主要基礎。在17個模型中，最佳準確率為85.29%。在凍結的Hard band上，最佳得分為全覆蓋追蹤的34.68%和372個上下文完整項目的54.57%。所有17個模型共享47個上下文完整的失敗。Function-RAG和FunctionGraph-RAG修正了數百個錯誤，但也推翻了許多正確答案，產生的淨增益很小或為負。僅在公共數據上訓練的門控根據問題和初始回應決定何時運行FunctionGraph-RAG。在5,088個保留項目中，門控對7.9%的問題調用FunctionGraph-RAG，並將準確率從70.83%提高到71.23%（p = .0446）。
